_noteQ: Q (Emberstrike): the auto-pick's 'Calc_Max_Health_Damage' tagged flat Physical was indeed the suspected bug (same pattern as Skarner P) -- ShyvanaQAbility/ShyvanaQ's Calc_Max_Health_Damage carries mDisplayAsPercent=true and is NamedDataValue(Max_Health_Damage=0.01 flat) + StatByNamedDataValue(mStat=2, mStatFormula=2 = BONUS AD, Max_Health_AD_Ratio=0.00011) -- a %TARGET-max-HP FRACTION formula tree (not flat damage), matching the wiki's passive on-hit line EXACTLY: 'deal bonus magic damage equal to 1% (+1.1% per 100 bonus AD) of the target's maximum health'. Re-wired via hpPercentCalc (Skarner-P-style) as a Magic bonusEffect triggered onHit (the wiki confirms this fires on every basic attack unconditionally, reducing Emberstrike's cooldown each time -- an innate on-hit passive, not gated on a prior Q cast). The min-10/max-200-against-non-champions clamp mentioned on wiki is not modeled (no clamp support in this schema) -- a documented, minor limitation. The REAL direct-cast hit is Calc_Damage = NamedDataValue(Base_Damage=[5,10,15,20,25,30,35]) + StatByNamedDataValue(mStat=2, TOTAL AD, Damage_AD_Ratio=1.1) + StatByCoefficient(no mStat = AP, 0.3) -- matches wiki 'Area Physical Damage: 10/15/20/25/30 (+110% AD) (+30% AP)' exactly; curated as the slot's direct Physical hit. Emberstrike is recastable (2 casts in Human Form dealing identical Calc_Damage each, per wiki 'Second Cast... dealing the same damage'), curated via castCount=2 (Ahri-R-style) rather than a flat count multiplier, since these are two independent real casts sharing one combo-editor node. The Dragon-Form-only 3rd cast (Calc_Dragon_Form_Damage = Calc_Damage x1.5, dealt as TRUE damage per wiki) is conditional on being transformed (R active) and is deliberately left uncurated, consistent with this project's Volibear-W conditional-empowerment precedent.
_noteW: W (Inferno Aegis): the initial cast only shields/speeds (no damage); the RECAST (shield consumed) explodes for real damage. ShyvanaWAbility/ShyvanaW's Damage = NamedDataValue(BaseDamage=[40,60,80,100,120,140,160]) + StatByCoefficient(no mStat = AP, 0.65) -- coefficient (65% AP) matches wiki 'Magic Damage: 80/100/120/140/160 (+65% AP)' exactly; base numbers are one 'step' lower than the current wiki tooltip (BIN idx1-5=60/80/100/120/140 vs wiki 80-160), treated as ordinary patch drift per the Hard Rule (the calc shape/type/AP-ratio match is the confirming signal; the live BIN value always resolves at runtime regardless). Curated as the slot's single Magic hit (the recast explosion).
_noteE: E (Molten Burst): ShyvanaEAbility/ShyvanaE's Damage = NamedDataValue(BaseDamage=[35,50,65,80,95,110,125]) + StatByNamedDataValue(no mStat = AP, DamageAPRatio=[0.55,0.6,0.65,0.7,0.75,0.8,0.85]) -- matches wiki 'Magic Damage: 50/65/80/95/110 (+60/65/70/75/80% AP)' exactly at idx1-5 (both base and the level-scaling AP ratio). Wiki additionally states '(+5% of target's maximum health)' as part of the SAME tooltip line (additive, not alternate) -- this maps directly to the flat DataValue 'MaxHealthDamage' (=0.05 constant), added as a second hit via hpPercentDataValue (simpler than hpPercentCalc since it's a plain DataValue array entry, unlike Q's embedded-in-formula case). Both hits summed = the wiki's full damage line. The scorched-ground DoT (DamagePerSecond calc: ByCharLevelBreakpoints 15/20/25 flat per-second, per wiki 'every 0.25 seconds... total maximum 30/40/50') is a genuine persistent zone/DoT the target can walk out of, but its rate is a FLAT number, not %HP -- this schema's only duration-scaled hit mechanism (perSecondHpPercent) is %HP-only, so per this project's established convention (omit rather than force/assume full duration), the DoT tick is NOT numerically modeled; the slot is tagged 'Zone' to document that a real, uncounted DoT component exists.
_noteR: R (Dragon's Descent) unchanged from the auto-pick's calc choice but re-verified: ShyvanaRAbility/ShyvanaR's Damage = NamedDataValue(BaseDamage=[50,150,250,350,...], 3 ranks) + StatByCoefficient(no mStat = AP, 1.0) -- matches wiki 'Magic Damage: 150/250/350 (+100% AP)' exactly at idx1-3; type Magic and calc name were already correct. Tagged 'BurstCeiling': the guaranteed instant fire-breath hit on transform/engage is Shyvana's single highest realistic burst contribution (Q/E are smaller pokes, W is a delayed/optional recast).
_noteQSplit: Q SPLIT INTO Q / Q2 / Q3 (loop 482, user request: no q1q2q3). Emberstrike was curated with castCount 2, which folded both human-form casts into one node - correct as a total, but it left no way to say only the first landed, and the dragon-form third cast was left out entirely under the Volibear-W conditional-empowerment precedent. All three are their own slot now. Live wiki (wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/Shyvana, fetched 2026-08-21) on the V26.10 rework: first cast a cone slash, second cast a tail slam for the SAME damage (both Calc_Damage = Base_Damage 10/15/20/25/30 + 110% AD + 30% AP), and in dragon form a THIRD cast, a bite for 150% of that dealt as TRUE damage (Calc_Dragon_Form_Damage = Calc_Damage x1.5, matching the wikis 15/22.5/30/37.5/45 (+165% AD) (+45% AP) exactly). Q3 is dragon-only, which is a fact about when the user places the node, not a condition the engine can read. The on-hit %maxHP passive stays on Q where it belongs - it fires on every basic attack whether or not Q was cast, so it is alwaysOn and does not follow the casts. ⚠️ castCount 2 is gone, so a saved Q node now scores ONE cast; add Q2 beside it.
